DataShape.name: AgentMessageData
DataShape.description: Data shape for agent message (Stream entry value row)

FieldDefinition.name: agentThing
FieldDefinition.description: AIAgent Thing name that produced this row

FieldDefinition.name: role
FieldDefinition.description: Message role: system, user, assistant, tool, ui_feedback, context_checkpoint

FieldDefinition.name: content
FieldDefinition.description: Message content (null when role=assistant with tool_calls only)

FieldDefinition.name: toolCalls
FieldDefinition.description: JSON array of tool calls (for role=assistant with tool_calls)

FieldDefinition.name: promptTokens
FieldDefinition.description: LLM prompt (input) tokens for this row’s assistant API round; 0 for user/tool

FieldDefinition.name: completionTokens
FieldDefinition.description: LLM completion (output) tokens for this row’s assistant API round; 0 for user/tool

FieldDefinition.name: llmUsageJson
FieldDefinition.description: Compact provider usage JSON for assistant rows; empty for user/tool

FieldDefinition.name: assistantMessageId
FieldDefinition.description: Stable server id for final assistant rows (feedback anchor); empty for user/tool/ui_feedback

FieldDefinition.name: executedToolName
FieldDefinition.description: LLM-facing tool id for role=tool (built-in or extended); empty when unknown; not duplicated in content JSON

FieldDefinition.name: hostContextSnapshotJson
FieldDefinition.description: Host context turn-state snapshot JSON for role=user; empty otherwise

FieldDefinition.name: chartGroupsJson
FieldDefinition.description: Final chart-group manifests (JSON array) for the final assistant row; empty otherwise
